notes:
Summary: enterprise health system evaluating a two-stage RAG pipeline (dense embeddings + cross-encoder reranker) for clinician-facing search across clinical notes, imaging reports, and pathology PDFs. High PHI sensitivity = strict audit trail, field-level redaction, and tenant isolation required.

Key scale targets: index ~120M documents (approx 6-8B tokens), expected active dataset ~25TB of raw text + attachments. Query profile: 15M queries/month peak (diurnal), 95th pct latency target <200ms for single-shot search, acceptable batch rerank window up to 500ms for deep rerank on critical queries. Cost target: <$0.002 per standard query (dense+rerank amortized), willing to trade some latency for lower cost on archive-tier queries.

Security & infra specifics: Okta SAML + SCIM required, integration with Azure Key Vault for envelope keys, detailed immutable audit logs (token-level and field-level) with 7+ year retention for compliance team. Preference for private deployment in customer's VPC or on-prem isolated bundle for high-compliance hospitals. Data residency: primary US regions, option for regional on-prem clusters.

POC scope & success metrics: 1) Indexing throughput: 10M docs/day ingest for initial run, 2) Recall@10 > 0.85 on clinical eval set, 3) Reranker improves MRR by 15% on physician queries, 4) 95p latency <200ms for cold queries, 5) Audit/logging verification from security team.

Technical preferences & asks from SE: two-tier index (sparse BM25 prefilter + 768-d embeddings), per-tenant encryption-at-rest + KMS integration, support for incremental indexing and nearline cold stores, quantized embedding store to reduce storage footprint, ability to push reranker to dedicated GPU pool for guaranteed perf. Also asked about automatic fallback to smaller model during Dedicated capacity shortfalls.

Conversation snippets / call notes: "We cannot accept a black-box SaaS — logs and SSO are table stakes." — Director of IT. "If the audit trail shows token-level events we can move forward; otherwise too risky." — Head of Compliance.

Recent activity: demo of Dedicated with Canary rollback (02/12), security questionnaire submitted (02/25), POC data export prepared (03/01). Next: schedule penetration test kickoff and internal security review (target week of 2026-03-22).

Documents: POC dataset (redacted) shared in Drive. Security FAQ and SOC2 evidence requested. Related support tickets for installer packaging and SSO test failures referenced.
